up: Retrieve distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds that have been tested in Homo sapiens assays against target CHEMBL3880 (HSP90). Use molecule_dictionary for chembl_id, compound_structures for canonical_smiles, activities to link compounds to assays, assays to filter by organism, and target_dictionary to identify the target. Filter on assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3880'. Return only the distinct pairs of molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3880'
  AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens';
